name: Stalza Backup
author: Fuad K M

sections.description:
Stalza Backup protects your WordPress site with chunked, resumable backups, integrity verification, and safe restore — without unnecessarily overloading your server.

Free includes

  • Manual backups: full, database, files, or media
  • Daily / weekly schedules with retention and exclusions
  • Local protected storage + download
  • Verification and backup manifests
  • Restore with pre-restore safety snapshot
  • WP-CLI for backup, restore, schedule, and jobs

Core principles

  • A backup is not successful until verified
  • Restore is as important as backup
  • Local backup works without an external account
  • Free version is genuinely useful
sections.installation:
1. Upload the stalza-backup folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Open Stalza Backup in the admin menu
sections.faq:
Does Free require a cloud account?

No. Local storage and download work without any external account.

Is verification Free?

Yes. Verification and backup manifests are core Free features.

How do scheduled backups run?

Through WordPress cron (stalza_backup_cron_run). On hosts where WP-Cron is unreliable, trigger it with a real system cron calling wp cron event run.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

Bug Fixes:

  • Stop writing $wpdb->prepare() % placeholder hashes into SQL dumps (Elementor settings="%7B%7D" / site-logo fatals).
  • Exclusive job lock so admin ticks and WP-Cron cannot double-append filelist.txt.
  • Heal prepare-placeholder corruption on restore and rewrite absolute URLs in uploads CSS (Elementor google-fonts CORS).
  • Remap option/usermeta keys and unknown collations when restoring custom table prefixes.
  • Stream large zip downloads with Range support; clear Plugin Check ERROR/WARNING findings.

Features:

  • Stronger site-to-site restore: prefix rewrite, serialize-safe URL remap, JSON-escaped URL pairs, and uploads text-file remaps.

1.0.5

Bug Fixes:

  • Set WordPress.org Contributors to valid username fuadkm.

1.0.4

Features:

  • Site-to-site restore: automatic table-prefix rewrite and serialize-safe URL remapping when source and destination differ.
  • Restore-completed modal with Go to login (sessions are usually reset after DB restore).

Bug Fixes:

  • Dump pagination uses ORDER BY primary/unique key so large tables do not emit duplicate PKs.
  • Persist SQL restore offset mid-tick and rewrite INSERT to REPLACE so resume cannot fail on Duplicate entry.
  • Restore ticks survive session wipe via tick token (omit stale REST nonce; clear cookie check when token present).
  • Harden staging cleanup and prune missing active_plugins after restore so incomplete plugin copies cannot fatal the site.

1.0.3

Features:

  • Import a Stalza backup zip from cloud or another site (Restore → Upload backup modal); verified before restore is offered.
  • Richer backup progress UI: live scan activity, elapsed time, rotating hints, and clearer phase titles.

1.0.2

Performance:

  • Scan phase uses a DFS stack cursor and prunes excluded directories (no O(N²) path re-walk). Mid-upgrade jobs still mid-scan with legacy resume restart that scan cleanly.
  • Admin REST ticks process up to 500 items / 20s (was 100 / 15s); cron job ticks match. Scan phase ignores the item cap and runs under time/memory only so listing finishes in one tick on typical sites.
  • Zip STORE for already-compressed media; light DEFLATE for text — less CPU, same zip format.
  • Archive seeks filelist.txt by byte offset (no full reload each tick); scan batch-appends the list.
  • Admin UI re-ticks ~every 50ms while a job runs (was 1.2s idle gap).

Bug Fixes:

  • Scan progress no longer shows a fake ~99% (N/(N+1)); UI shows files found with an indeterminate bar until archive/dump has a real total.

Full history: https://stalza.com/docs/stalza-backup/changelog
